title: ddRADSeq in a Field Setting
author: Mrinalini Watsa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y2efybe
materials: In a MiniOne PCR System (PCR thermocycler, MiniOne, M4000, https://theminione.com/product/minione-pcr-system/ ) heat the mixture at 80 °C for 00:01:00
Further dilute the adapter to 5uM with 0.5X Buffer AE Qiagen Catalog #19077 in 1.5ml tube. E.g Add 40 µL of annealed adapter and 360 µL 0.5X AE.
In a thermocylcer heat the mixture at 80 °C for 00:01:00
Further dilute the adapter to 25uM with 0.5 X Buffer AE Qiagen Catalog #19077 in 1.5ml tube. E.g Add 100 µL of annealed adapter and 100 µL 0.5X AE.
Choose the OneDNA protocol on the Quantus fluorometer.
Return the SV Minicolumn to the Collection Tube.

steps.title: Resuspend and anneal P1 adapters
steps.instruction: Resuspend each P1 oligo to 100 µM in 0.5 X AE Buffer (Qiagen) following the supplier’s instructions. In a PCR tube combine equal volumes of forward and reverse oligos (e.g., 20 µL P1F_X + 20 µL P1R_X) to obtain a 50 µM adapter solution. Place the tube on a rack at 24 °C (room temperature) and let it cool for at least 30 min. Store the annealed P1 adapter at 4 °C for short‑term use or at –20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Resuspend and anneal P2 adapters
steps.instruction: Resuspend each P2 oligo to 100 µM in 0.5 X AE Buffer (Qiagen) as above. Mix equal volumes of the forward and reverse P2 oligos (e.g., 50 µL P2F_MspI + 50 µL P2R_MspI) in a PCR tube to obtain a 50 µM adapter. Cool at 24 °C for at least 30 min. Store the annealed P2 adapter at 4 °C or –20 °C.

steps.title: Dilute P1 adapter to working concentration
steps.instruction: Further dilute the annealed P1 adapter to 5 µM with 0.5 X AE Buffer in a 1.5 mL tube (e.g., add 40 µL annealed adapter + 360 µL 0.5 X AE). Store at 4 °C or –20 °C.

steps.title: Dilute P2 adapter to working concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute the annealed P2 adapter to 25 µM with 0.5 X AE Buffer in a 1.5 mL tube (e.g., add 100 µL annealed adapter + 100 µL 0.5 X AE). Store at 4 °C or –20 °C.

steps.title: Aliquot adapters into labeled tubes
steps.instruction: Label individual PCR tubes for each adapter. Add 19 µL nuclease‑free water to each tube, then add 1 µL of the appropriate diluted adapter (P1 or P2). Seal, vortex briefly, and centrifuge to collect the mixture.

steps.title: Elute DNA from FTA disks (Elution A & B)
steps.instruction: Using a sterile scalpel or hole punch, take 1–3 (2–3 mm) punches from an FTA card and place them into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. Rinse each disk three times with 500 µL ddH₂O, vortexing 5 s each time. Transfer the disk to a pre‑labeled 0.8 mL PCR tube, add 45–50 µL ddH₂O to fully cover the disk, spin down, then heat at 95 °C for 30 min. Pulse‑vortex or tap 60 times, centrifuge 30 s, and transfer the supernatant to a labeled tube (Elution A). Add 30 µL ddH₂O to the same disk, repeat the rinse‑heat‑vortex‑centrifuge steps to obtain Elution B. Store eluates at 4 °C for short‑term use or at –20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion of blood sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the blood sample for 1 min, add 10 µL Proteinase K, and incubate overnight at 65–70 °C until the supernatant turns light orange.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.instruction: To the tube containing 200 µL Longmire’s solution with blood, add 500 µL Binding Buffer and incubate 10 min at 65–70 °C. Add 500 µL 96 % ethanol, pulse‑vortex 5 times, then centrifuge at 16,000 g for 2 min. Transfer the supernatant to a spin‑column (load 500 µL at a time), centrifuge each load at 6,000 g for 2 min, discarding the flow‑through each time.

steps.title: Wash spin column
steps.instruction: Add 720 µL Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 6,000 g for 2 min and discard the flow‑through. Then centrifuge the column at 10,000 g for 4 min and discard the liquid.

steps.title: Elute DNA from spin column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column (caps off) at 56 °C for 15 min to evaporate residual ethanol. Meanwhile heat ~2 mL elution buffer to 56 °C. Add 20 µL elution buffer directly onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 10 min, then centrifuge at 10,000 g for 5 min to collect DNA. Repeat with 30 µL elution buffer for a second elution (or combine with the first). Store the eluate at 4 °C or –20 °C.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Calibrate the Qubit: fill a Qubit assay tube with 200 µL dye and click ‘Blank’. Prepare a labeled assay tube for each sample, add 200 µL dye, and cover with aluminium foil. Vortex and spin down. Add 1 µL of each DNA sample to the corresponding assay tube, vortex, spin, and incubate at 24 °C (or RT) for 5 min. Measure fluorescence, record concentration in ng/µL. For the standard, add 400 µL dye + 2 µL Lambda DNA to a new assay tube, click ‘Standard’, then ‘Save’.

steps.title: Prepare PCR reaction (template addition)
steps.instruction: Label a PCR tube for each sample. Add 9 µL sample buffer (green cap). Dilute template DNA to 10 ng/µL; add 1 µL of this DNA (add more if concentration is lower; the authors added 3 µL in that case). Heat the mixture at 95 °C for 3 min, then cool to 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare and add Master Mix
steps.instruction: For each amplification reaction, combine 9 µL Reaction Buffer (blue cap) with 1 µL Enzyme Buffer (yellow cap) on ice to make the Master Mix. Transfer 10 µL of Master Mix to each sample tube.

steps.title: Incubate whole‑genome amplification
steps.instruction: Incubate the reactions at 30 °C for 1 h 30 min (extend an additional 30 min if starting DNA concentration is low). Samples may be stored at 4 °C after incubation.

steps.title: Prepare ligation master mix (no adapters)
steps.instruction: In a 2 mL tube combine all ligation reagents except the P1 adapters and genomic DNA according to the provided ligation table (or the alternative table if exact concentrations are unavailable). Vortex briefly and centrifuge.

steps.title: Add adapters and DNA to ligation mix
steps.instruction: Aliquot 19 µL of the ligation master mix into each well of a PCR strip tube or plate. Add 1 µL of the appropriate P1 adapter to each well, then add 20 µL of the corresponding genomic DNA sample. Mix gently by pipetting up and down with a 30 µL pipette a few times.

steps.title: Ligation incubation program
steps.instruction: Seal the PCR strip tubes (snap caps down, contents settled). Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, then at 20 °C for 1 h, and finally hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 % agarose gel (≈19 mL agarose + 1.5 µL gel dye) using the MiniOne system with a 6‑tooth comb. Load each sample together with a 100 bp ladder. Run the gel for ~25 min until the 1000 bp band is clearly distinguished from the 1500 bp ladder. Photograph the gel for records.

steps.title: Gel‑slice cleanup with Wizard SV kit
steps.instruction: Weigh an empty 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and record its weight. Using a gel excision tip, cut out the desired band(s) from each lane, combine all slices in the tube, and photograph the excised gel. Add Membrane Binding Solution at 10 µL per 10 mg gel, vortex, and incubate at 56 °C for 10 min (vortex every few minutes). Centrifuge briefly at room temperature. Place a SV Minicolumn in a collection tube, transfer the dissolved gel mixture onto the column, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 16,000 g for 1 min. Discard flow‑through. Wash the column with 700 µL Membrane Wash Solution, centrifuge 1 min at 16,000 g, discard. Repeat wash with 500 µL Membrane Wash Solution, centrifuge 5 min at 16,000 g, discard. Spin the column open for 1 min to evaporate residual ethanol. Transfer the column to a clean 1.5 mL tube, add 20 µL nuclease‑free water to the membrane, centrifuge 1 min at 16,000 g. Re‑elute with 30 µL (or combine with the first eluate) and centrifuge 5 min at 10,000 g. Collect the DNA (~18–19 µL) and store at 4 °C or –20 °C.
